scenes.text: The four cardinal directions are north, east, south and west; a quarter-turn moves to the next direction.
Face south. Turn a quarter-turn right. Which way now? The answer is west. Use the compass order N–E–S–W; after turning, face west.
A learner faces south at a market stall and turns half a turn. Which direction is faced next? Pause the video and think.
A learner faces south at a market stall and turns half a turn. Which direction is faced next? The answer is north. Use the compass order N–E–S–W; after turning, face north.
